record.dic_text:
01340 Bath-Shuwa` {bat-shu:'-a}

源自 01323 和 07771; 陰性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Bathshua 1, variant for Shua 1; 2

拔書亞 = "財富之女"
1) 烏利亞的妻子, 大衛王和她發生姦情並謀殺了烏利亞 (#撒下 11; 12|);
   她後來成為大衛王的眾妻之一, 為大衛生下了所羅門, 示米亞, 朔罷, 拿單
   (另一拼法是 01339 Bathsheba 拔示巴) (#代上 3:5|)
2) 猶大的妻子 (#代上 2:3|)
record.edic_text:
01340 Bath-Shuwa` {bath-shoo'-ah}

from 01323 and 07771;; n pr f

AV - Bathshua 1, variant for Shua 1; 2

Bath-shua = "daughter of wealth"
1) the wife of Uriah whom David had murdered, having had adulterous
   relations with her; subsequently wife of David and mother of Solomon,
   Shimea, Shobab, and Nathan (alternate spelling to 'Bathsheba')
2) wife of Judah
